paragraphs.text: The northern side of the village is bustling and you are unlikely to remain hidden there for long. You head in the direction of the church, and then move up the east side, behind the houses. A drop looms on your right. One particular section of ground is quite narrow and you have to hug the building for support.

You may give this approach up and go to 120. To proceed, compare your SIZ to your DEX. If your DEX is higher, go to 42. If your SIZ is higher, make a  roll. If you succeed, go to 42. If you fail, go to 36.
